title: Replace cap tests enum with the proof string contract
action: In finish_support.rs, replace the --report tests value contract (validator parse_report_flag, the refusal that currently says tests must be "boundary" or "undeclared"): accept a proof string `<command> — <result> — <scope reason>` (per D8) — three non-empty segments, split on the FIRST TWO ' — ' separators only, so the reason may itself contain ' — '. Make --report REQUIRED at cells finish (per plan door contract; today it is optional and absent-report caps never touch trace.report — that absent shape remains legal only for pre-contract caps, which the doors grandfather). Refuse the legacy enum words with a remedy teaching the new form (per D1). A result segment reading `red` refuses the cap — per the plan test matrix, D6's spirit: a red is fix-first, never a done. In a no-test-sentinel repo the command segment is `none` with the reason naming the parity/docs proof used; migrate the existing sentinel-pinning tests in cells/tests.rs to this form (the legacy vocabulary appears 4 times there; drivers/tests.rs has zero hits — leave it alone). Note: packages/bee/prompts/worker-cell.md line ~40 currently documents tests: "green|red" — it is WRONG today, not merely outdated; rewrite the Result-form to the proof string with one example. Never hand-edit .bee/bin/prompts/worker-cell.md: after editing the canonical prompt, run the regen chain `.bee/bin/bee dev regen` (render-skill-trees → onboard --apply → release-manifest --write) — it writes the vendored copy and the manifest; both stay listed in files so the reservation covers them. The `cells cap` verb has NO report parameter today (registry commands[12] parameters: id, outcome, files, deviations-file, deviation, friction, override-judge, session-id, force-ownership, json) — add required --report there with the same proof-string contract, same validator, so no cap path can land report-less (a cap verb left without --report would grandfather every future cap as legacy, a permanent D7 hole); its handler shares the finish path (find it via rg 'cells cap' / commands[12] handler, likely handlers_close.rs). Update BOTH help rows in generated/registry_payload.json (hand-maintained per decision 3358743e): cells-finish AND cells-cap — the cap row still teaches 'Tests prove at the boundary — bee close runs commands.test…' verbatim.
verify: PATH="${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}/bin:$PATH" cargo test --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml -p bee && .bee/bin/bee dev release-manifest --check && bee onboard --repo-root . --json && diff packages/bee/prompts/worker-cell.md .bee/bin/prompts/worker-cell.md

A cap whose result segment is red is refused
